dedupe_keys.name: energy intensity level of primary energy

description: Energy Intensity Level of Primary Energy is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains GCC and USA Energy Intensity Level of Primary Energy for the period 1990-2015. Data from World Bank. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Energy intensity level of primary energy is the ratio between energy supply and gross domestic product measured at purchasing power parity. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Climate & Sustainability. Its keywords are Sustainable Energy, Intensity. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
